scripts.check:syntax: for file in js/*.js compat/*.js scripts/*.cjs test/*.cjs test/browser/*.js playwright.config.js; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:node
scripts.test:release: npm run build && node scripts/release-smoke.cjs && NO_COLOR= FORCE_COLOR=0 FORGE_PLAYWRIGHT_LANE=release playwright test --workers=1
